title: USA Today: Arianna Huffington's Thrive Global teams with Labcorp on new Thrive 5 Health Test
summary: Arianna Huffington's behavior change company Thrive Global has joined forces with Labcorp to launch the Thrive 5 Health Test, a simple cardiometabolic test available at Labcorp patient service centers nationwide, USA Today reports.
body_markdown:
Arianna Huffington's behavior change company Thrive Global has joined forces with Labcorp to launch the Thrive 5 Health Test, a simple cardiometabolic test available at Labcorp patient service centers nationwide, *USA Today* reports.


**Why it matters:** As consumers increasingly chase comprehensive health data through full-body MRIs and wearable health trackers, the Thrive 5 Health Test cuts through the noise, positioning Labcorp as the testing backbone that turns lab results into meaningful, accessible health insights patients can act on. ****


**Key takeaway:** The Thrive 5 Health Test distills the wellness era's data overload into five actionable cardiometabolic metrics, ApoB, hs-CRP, HbA1c, blood pressure and BMI, giving consumers clear numbers and practical next steps instead of endless data points.


The test costs $159, is HSA/FSA eligible and can be taken most Labcorp locations. Huffington told USA Today that the goal is simplicity, "There's such passion about the quantified self, and what has been missing is how do we turn all those numbers into real health insights and into actionable next steps?"


**Read the full article in**[USA Today](https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/health-wellness/2026/10/29/arianna-huffington-thrive-5-health-test/92462877007/) **.**
